claim_gate.reason: The compact frame identity and conditional LCU schema are exact, and the natural-source theorem now validates the small-character-ratio envelope with overwhelming probability. Direct normalization is therefore exponentially weak at growing width unless structured amplification or a different PGM implementation avoids it.

falsifiers_triggered: The PGM average frame does have a compact all-k algebraic description; explicit hidden-orbit matrices are unnecessary for stating the operator.
Expanding all subset class averages explicitly still uses 2^k terms and is invalid at growing width.
Finite condition number controls relative spectrum only; it does not remove absolute block-encoding normalization.
The natural character-ratio concentration theorem validates the envelope but does not lower-bound non-LCU measurements.
summary: Verified the all-k subset identity and projected-LCU proportionality on 84 natural S_5 source branches. The natural-source ratio theorem discharges the hard-sector envelope; 3/4 growing-width rows have superpolynomial generic square-root amplification cost.

theorem_contract.conditional_scaling_assumption: Every sampled source in the hard-sector envelope obeys |chi_lambda(C)|/d_lambda <= 1/sqrt(n). The companion natural character-ratio theorem proves this simultaneously for the complete growing-width source tuple except with probability at most 2kn/|C|.
theorem_contract.exact_identity: F_lambda = product_i(d_i+chi_i(C))^-1 times the sum over all register subsets S of the class average of the diagonal representation on S.
theorem_contract.normalization_formula: The normalized projected operator B has mean eigenvalue product_i(1+chi_i/d_i)/2. Generic rescaling to unit average therefore costs product_i 2/(1+chi_i/d_i).
projected_lcu_schema: Coherently prepare a uniform hidden conjugacy-class element.
For each copy, prepare an equal I-versus-representation selector.
Apply source-irrep representation matrices controlled by the class element.
Unprepare class and selector registers to project the normalized average.
schema_dependencies: Uniform controlled Young-representation action for sampled source partitions.
Ordinary mixed coset-state access does not itself provide this projected block encoding.
